mathematical_model.description: One homogeneous binary birth-death founder; constant division lambda and death mu; independent identical daughters; random tag chooses one daughter independently of future fate; select any-descendant survival at T and retain tag even if it dies.
mathematical_model.validity_window: 0 <= t <= T; observed lifetime is right-censored at T
mathematical_model.post_horizon_boundary: If tag remains alive at T, later death hazard reverts to mu. Do not equate the complete uncensored lifetime to the two-stage law.
mathematical_model.equivalent_observed_law: Independent Exp(lambda)+Exp(mu), with the same right censoring at T
mathematical_model.symmetry: Selected death times alone are invariant to exchange lambda and mu.
mathematical_model.conditional_intensity_scope: Marginal over the selected at-risk histories; not a claim that every tagged history has the same Markov transition rates.
mathematical_model.zero_rate_limits: lambda=0 implies selected tag survives to T; mu=0 or both0 implies no death.

subcritical_Q_process.published_ingredients: Spine birth rate m*lambda; one uniform continuing spine daughter; other subtrees ordinary and independent.
subcritical_Q_process.binary_tagged_corollary: For m=2, random tag exits spine at rate lambda, then dies at rate mu; independent exponential sum.
subcritical_Q_process.status: project specialization of explicitly published preprint construction

critical_Q_process.project_rate_calculation: h(n)=n gives upward k(n+1) and downward k(n-1), realized by n-1 ordinary cells plus a spine splitting at 2k. Tag exit at rate k followed by death at rate k gives Erlang-2.
critical_Q_process.status: project specialization; not a quoted continuous-state theorem

supercritical_infinite_survival.project_rate_calculation: q=mu/lambda. Doomed branches have division rate lambda*q=mu and death rate mu/q=lambda. An immortal parent produces one immortal and one doomed daughter at rate 2lambda*q=2mu. A uniform tag enters the doomed branch at rate mu, then dies at rate lambda.
supercritical_infinite_survival.status: project conditional-branching corollary using published extinction transformation

priority_addendum.finite_horizon_boundary: These infinite-horizon or Q-process interpretations do not prove exact finite-T equality. The independently derived Poisson-functional identity and numerical checks remain the proof/check on 0<=t<=T, with post-T death hazard mu.
priority_addendum.originality_decision: Downgrade to explicit finite-window derivation, reproducible benchmark and application/identifiability audit rooted in standard branching constructions; no new-theorem or first-ever claim.
